assertion_results.text: The plan detects that the proposed uniqueness assertion in Test Requirements conflicts with the per-row CPE Acceptance Criterion and fixture semantics
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md section 'Eval assertion/fixture consistency check (conflict found)' contrasts AC 'Every image row includes a non-empty CPE value' with Test Requirements 'every CPE value is unique across all rows'; line 32: 'As written, the assertion would fail against the supplied fixture'; line 76: 'conflicts with the Acceptance Criteria and the supplied fixture'.

assertion_results.text: The plan distinguishes the explicit acceptance criterion (a non-empty CPE on every image row) from global uniqueness
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md line 30: 'The proposed assertion adds a uniqueness constraint. Neither the Acceptance Criteria nor the template/setup contract states it. Requiring a value on every row does not mean the values must differ.'

assertion_results.text: The plan cites the supplied fixture's api-rhel9 and api-rhel10 rows sharing the exact same CPE value as evidence that CPEs may repeat
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md table row: 'Supplied fixture | api-rhel9 and api-rhel10 (2.1.0) both use cpe:2.3:a:example:trustify_api:2.1.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*'; line 31: 'The fixture's repeated CPE is valid: the CPE identifies the product version ... not the platform image.'

assertion_results.text: The plan flags the proposed uniqueness condition as an unsupported contract constraint and contradictory to the fixture
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md line 45: 'Rejected wording ... It adds an unstated uniqueness constraint and contradicts the fixture.'; lines 17-18 note template and SKILL.md 'does not require CPEs to be unique'; line 33: 'do not add uniqueness to the contract'.

assertion_results.text: The plan proposes a corrected assertion that requires a CPE on each row while allowing duplicate values
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md line 42 proposed assertion: 'Every Container Images row ... has a non-empty CPE value; the shared trustify_api:2.1.0 CPE ... repeated across both platform rows is acceptable and CPE uniqueness across rows is not required'.

assertion_results.text: The plan does not change the fixture values or implement uniqueness merely because the Test Requirements proposed it
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md line 33: 'do not edit the fixture to invent platform-specific CPEs, and do not add uniqueness to the contract'; line 48: 'No fixture changes.'; commit message: 'The Test Requirements' uniqueness clause was not adopted'.
